name: Goldstar Power Ltd.
summary: Goldstar Power Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer specializing in lead-acid batteries and related components, operating primarily within the energy storage and automotive sectors. The company manufactures and assembles a diverse range of batteries, including automotive batteries for cars, tractors, and heavy-duty trucks, tubular batteries for inverter and solar applications, e-rickshaws, VRLA batteries for UPS systems, and motorcycle batteries. Goldstar Power also produces pure lead and lead alloys. The company markets its products under the GOLDSTAR brand and serves domestic, after-market, and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) segments, with an expanding export presence in African and Middle Eastern markets. Its integrated manufacturing facility in Jamnagar, Gujarat, encompasses lead smelting, refining, and automated battery assembly.
